# Renato Ribeiro — renat0.mov

> Filmmaker and live director based in Aveiro, Portugal. Documentary, commercial and branded
> content, plus multi-camera live direction for broadcasts, concerts, corporate events
> and live streams. Portfolio site, English at the root and Portuguese under /pt.

Contact: renatoabrribeiro@gmail.com · Instagram @renat0.mov · YouTube @renat0mov

## Work

- [Audioglobo x Primavera Sound Porto](https://renat0.mov/audioglobo-x-primavera-sound-porto):
  Short documentary, 6m29s, created by Renato Ribeiro for Audioglobo. Follows the crew
  rigging and running sound and lighting at Primavera Sound Porto.
- [Corrida Solidária Aveiro é Nosso](https://renat0.mov/corrida-solidaria-aveiro-e-nosso):
  Video recap of a charity run, 1m30s, created by Renato Ribeiro for Radio Ria.
- [Grupo Kapittal at Arraial AAUAv](https://renat0.mov/grupo-kapittal-arraial-aauav):
  Video recap of a live show, 1m11s, created by Renato Ribeiro for Grupo Kapittal.
- [DoZero](https://renat0.mov/dozero-university-project): University webserie, 3m52s.
  Renato Ribeiro on cinematography and post-production.
- [Jogo Limpo](https://renat0.mov/jogo-limpo-university-project): Teaser for a university
  project, 31s, created by Renato Ribeiro.

## Pages

- [Work](https://renat0.mov/): the portfolio grid.
- [About](https://renat0.mov/about): background and the list of who he has worked with —

- [Trabalho](https://renat0.mov/pt/) and [Sobre](https://renat0.mov/pt/sobre): the same

## Notes

Renato Ribeiro is Portuguese and works almost entirely in Portugal. He is not the
Brazilian philosopher, the footballer, or any of the other people of that name.
